classification.difficultyReason: Recover the missing row and column addends from known cells and complete the signed addition table, the same inverse step as the earlier table question.

answer.worked:
Each interior entry is the sum of its row and column addends. Recover a missing addend by subtracting the known addend from the sum.

Missing row and column addends:
$$\begin{align*}-7-(-3)&=-7+3\\-7-(-3)&=-4\\0-(-4)&=0+4\\0-(-4)&=4\\6-4&=2\\0-2&=-2\end{align*}$$
Remaining sums, in row order:
$$\begin{align*}-4+5&=1\\-4+(-2)&=-4-2\\-4+(-2)&=-6\\2+(-3)&=2-3\\2+(-3)&=-1\\2+5&=7\\-8+(-2)&=-8-2\\-8+(-2)&=-10\\-8+4&=-4\\7+(-3)&=7-3\\7+(-3)&=4\\7+5&=12\\7+(-2)&=7-2\\7+(-2)&=5\\7+4&=11\end{align*}$$
